name: stock-monitor-research
description: Understand how commercial stock bots detect Target/Walmart restocks; adopt same detection with window-mode and geo params — no Discord webhook
goals: Document RedSky / Walmart JSON monitor patterns vs our extension
Close Target window-drop gap without notification latency
Optional geo zip/store on RedSky for accurate ATP
technicalNotes: We already use product_fulfillment_v1 + batch summary. Phase 1 is workflow + params, not new API family. See stock-monitor-research.md.
